mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 65 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park under a Waning Gibbous moon, and the temperature will dip to a low of 62 degrees with rain predicted overnight.

The Verona Water Utility is partnering with experts to conduct cross connection surveys to prevent water contamination, so watch your mail for an appointment notice. Also, keep in mind that road construction will close a portion of Highway M from October 6 through October 9, so please follow the detours.

It is a busy week in town. Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Farmer's Market, trivia at The Bogey Factory, or Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Art Bar happy hour or Hop Haus trivia.
Regarding local activity, on September 21, officers were alerted to a retail theft where a suspect made off with Swedish Fish candy, but the individual was later identified and cited.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Double Strawberry. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 40 minutes, so make sure to get there before they wrap up for the night.
